method.temperature: Calibrated local air temperature at ATS1 (ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1), kelvin.
method.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of accepted samples; min/max of accepted ATS1 observations. Not a full-sol time-weighted mean.
method.quality: PDS missing-value code 999999999, blank, non-finite and non-positive values omitted; LMST sol checked and repeated SCLK records deduplicated. Selected ATS/PS products have no per-sample quality-flag columns.
method.coverage: Historical observations at the rover, not a forecast or a weather map. Gaps are not filled.
